name: Duekoue

routes.outcome: Official SIGFU portal discovered. It describes Côte d'Ivoire's integrated urban-land management system and links to parcel/lotissement services. Search evidence is general service discovery, not proof that a Duekoue parcel layer was queried.

Official French parcel-search page discovered. It describes searching approved lotissements and lots by localité and displaying parcel results. The request environment could not fetch the live page for JavaScript/configuration inspection because TLS certificate verification failed.
Direct curl request failed before HTTP response with certificate verification error (curl error 60: unable to get local issuer certificate). No TLS exception was authorized or used.

Official AFOR rural-land geoportal discovered. Its public description says parcels load after zooming and supports search. This is a relevant public viewer, but no Duekoue parcel response, native ID, schema, CRS, or geometry was obtained.

Direct curl request was attempted for viewer HTML/configuration but failed before HTTP response with the same certificate verification error. No certificate exception, login, or private token was used.
Official DGI Cadastre page found. It describes the Direction du Cadastre and a tax-notice service, but exposes no anonymous parcel map/API or safe parcel geometry.

Official IDUFCI page found. It explains a unique identifier intended for every parcel in Côte d'Ivoire and says access is pilot/professional-oriented; no anonymous Duekoue geometry endpoint was exposed in the discovery result.

Official budget document names a Service du Cadastre de Duékoué and a budget line for managing the cadastre and land property. This is local custodian evidence, not an operational public parcel service.

viewerInspection.reason: The public search pages were discoverable, but direct live HTML retrieval for SIGFU and AFOR failed certificate verification in the request environment. No login or TLS bypass was used, so current JavaScript/configuration and API routes could not be inspected safely.

uncertainty: Official discovery establishes relevant national and local custodians/services but not a successful anonymous Duekoue parcel query.
SIGFU urban coverage and AFOR rural coverage are distinct; neither was independently confirmed at the exact WUP point.
No exact-point hit, map extent test, or citywide absence claim was made.
Runtime adapter qualification is held pending serial review and a real public parcel response.
